description: This file defines an Android Activity named RotationAnimation that handles UI interactions to change window rotation animations and fullscreen mode, including setting event listeners for UI controls and updating window attributes accordingly.

classes.name: RotationAnimation
classes.description: An Android Activity that demonstrates changing window rotation animation modes and fullscreen mode through UI controls.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the UI layout, and attaches listeners to UI controls for changing rotation animation and fullscreen mode.

methods.name: setFullscreen
methods.description: Enables or disables fullscreen mode on the window.

methods.name: setRotationAnimation
methods.description: Sets the window's rotation animation mode.
